verdict.rationale: The evidence shows built-in automation, such as auto-booking, AI categorization, automated reconciliation and the agentic close, plus webhook event delivery to developer endpoints. None of it documents a way for users to define their own rules that trigger actions on events. Webhooks are a developer building block and vendor-run automation is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for user-defined event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
